items.q: The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) won the election in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt. In an interview with Phoenix TV, the AfD lead candidate Ulrich Siegmund said that for Germany’s better development in the future, Germany needs China from a long-term perspective.
items.a: Regional elections in Germany are its domestic affair. China will not comment on that. China’s position on developing its relations with Germany is consistent.

items.q: The United States and China will hold talks on AI safety risks in coming weeks. This is according to a recent report by Reuters. Can the foreign ministry confirm these talks? They will reportedly take place in mid-September. What are Chinese expectations for these discussions?
items.a: China and the U.S. maintain communication on AI.

items.q: Venezuela says its agreements with China will be respected and Chinese joint ventures will continue operating. Has Caracas given Beijing specific assurances that Chinese oil interests will not be affected by the new U.S.-Venezuela agreement?
items.a: Cooperation between China and Venezuela is under the protection of international law and laws of both countries. It has nothing to do with any third party and should not be disrupted by any third party. China’s lawful rights and interests in Venezuela must be protected.

items.q: We spoke to the Philippines’ defense secretary earlier today and he said China could use recently scaled-down U.S.-South Korean military exercises as an opportunity to assert itself in the Indo-Pacific region. Do you have anything to say to that comment?
items.a: China is always committed to maintaining peace and stability in the Asia Pacific, and does not engage in major-country confrontation. We hope other regional countries will also play a positive role for peace and stability in the region.

During the visit, they travelled to Hunchun, Dunhua and Haerbaling in Jilin Province to inspect the excavation, recovery and destruction of Japan’s ACWs. items.q: India is scheduled to host a BRICS summit this weekend. Can the foreign ministry confirm who will be attending on China’s behalf? Secondly, what are China’s expectations for this BRICS summit?
items.a: China sets great store by BRICS cooperation. We support India in hosting a successful BRICS summit this year. For your specific questions, I don’t have more information to offer at the moment.

items.q: We noted recent comments saying China only cares for its own development while “pulling up the ladder” for the development of other Global South countries. What is your comment?
items.a: China never pulls up the ladder from any country. Rather, China has long been building up ladders so that countries could reach higher together. Through high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, for instance, China has been helping partner countries bridge the infrastructure gap. By providing Global South countries with affordable industrial equipment and tech products and sharing experience and expertise, China has helped lower the cost for these countries’ industrial growth. items.a: We will release timely information if there is any update. Please stay tuned.

items.a: I’m not familiar with the specifics. China-India economic and trade cooperation is mutually beneficial in nature. We hope India will provide a fair, just, transparent and non-discriminatory environment for the investment and operation of companies of all countries in India.

items.a: China released a readout on Foreign Minister Wang Yi’s meeting with U.S. Ambassador to China David Perdue. China will work with LAC countries and other parties to jointly build a just and equitable global AI governance system, and develop AI for the good of people worldwide.

items.a: I don’t have any information to provide.

items.q: Could you please comment on China’s announcement to increase visa fees for Japanese citizens travelling to China?
items.a: The Chinese Embassy in Japan has issued a notice. The adjustment was made based on the principle of reciprocity.

For China, innovation is never about monopoly. We are committed to sharing innovation dividends with the world to thrive together.

items.a: China always strictly fulfills its due international obligations. We oppose exploiting the conflict to throw mud at China.

items.a: AI is a consequential technology for the wellbeing of all humanity. All parties should jointly promote the open and inclusive development of AI for good and for all. Fear-mongering, confrontation and vicious competition will only hamper efforts toward sound global AI governance, which serves no one’s interest.

Once the remains of any foreign national are found and after the identity is confirmed, the relevant embassy will be contacted to communicate follow-up arrangements. The Xizang Autonomous Region authorities have opened a hotline for families of the missing foreign nationals and will provide them with timely assistance.

Yesterday morning, a Philippine Coast Guard vessel, without China’s permission, intruded the adjacent waters of Ren’ai Jiao, Nansha Qundao of China. China Coast Guard took legitimate and reasonable measures to handle the situation in accordance with laws and regulations. items.q: You just announced the upcoming visit by President Boko. Could you please share the program of the visit and China’s expectations? How does China view the current China-Botswana relations?
items.a: The upcoming visit will mark President Boko’s first visit to China since assuming office. During the visit, President Xi will host a welcoming ceremony and a banquet for President Boko, and the two heads of state will hold talks. Premier Li Qiang and Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee Zhao Leji will meet with him respectively. President Boko will also visit Fujian Province. China and Botswana are strategic partners.
